{{Tprice|200}} (1.26% chance, any season) }} The '''Rare Seed''' is a type of seed. A mature plant yields a [[Sweet Gem Berry]]. One to five Rare Seeds can be purchased at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Price|1000}} each during [[Spring]] and [[Summer]]. During any season, there is also a 1.26% chance that the merchant will be selling 1-5 Rare Seeds for {{Tprice|200}} each. (It is possible for Rare Seeds to occupy two slots in the merchant's offerings in Spring and Summer). Rare Seeds can also be obtained by using the [[Seed Maker]]. Despite the description stating that this seed "''takes all season to grow''", it takes only 24 days. If using [[fertilizer]] that speeds crop growth or having the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Agriculturist Profession]], it will take fewer days. ==Stages== {{#lsth:Sweet Gem Berry|Stages}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Tips== *The Seed Maker creates an average of two seeds from one [[Sweet Gem Berry]] 97.5% of the time. Since a [[Sweet Gem Berry]] is worth at least {{Price|3000}}, each Rare Seed produced from the Seed Maker is created at a cost of {{Price|1500}} to {{Price|3000}} depending on the quality of the input. This makes the maximum price of {{Price|1000}} at the [[Traveling Cart]] a much better buy, even though the quantities offered there are limited. ==Notes== A [[Livin' Off The Land]] tip (Fall 1, Year 2) informs the player that Rare Seeds take only 24 days to grow, and not a full season (28 days). {{NavboxSeeds}} [[Category:Fall seeds]] [[de:Seltene Saat]] [[es:Semilla rara]] [[fr:Graine rare]] [[it:Seme raro]] [[ja:珍しいタネ]] [[ko:희귀한 씨앗]] [[hu:Ritka magvak]] [[pt:Semente rara]] [[ru:Редкое семечко]] [[tr:Ender Tohum]] [[zh:稀有种子]]
